disclaimer: Prices are indicative only and subject to final assessment by a licensed dentist. Treatment outcomes vary by individual. This platform is an information and referral service; all clinics are independently licensed medical institutions in China.

whyChina.title: Up to 60% Savings
whyChina.text: Compared with the US, UK or Australia, dental treatment in China can cost a fraction — without compromising on materials or standards.

whyChina.title: Licensed & Accredited
whyChina.text: Every partner clinic holds a valid Chinese Medical Institution License and employs board-certified dentists. We verify before we list.

whyChina.title: Turn Recovery Into a Trip
whyChina.text: Heal in Guizhou's karst wonderlands or explore imperial Beijing — your treatment doubles as an unforgettable holiday.

whyChina.title: English-Speaking Coordination
whyChina.text: From first message to aftercare, our bilingual team coordinates every step via WhatsApp, email and video call.

process.title: Tell Us Your Needs
process.text: Message us on WhatsApp or email. Share your X-rays, concerns and travel dates.

process.title: Get a Plan & Quote
process.text: We match you with a licensed clinic and send a transparent treatment plan with price ranges.

process.title: Plan Your Trip
process.text: We suggest destinations, accommodation and a relaxed itinerary around your appointments.

process.title: Treat & Travel
process.text: Receive care from certified specialists, then enjoy China with peace of mind.
